reviews.title: S7 is liar
reviews.text: They never refund the money with many lies especially for foreigners like me. In my case, I bought the ticket with my card so they can refund money to my credit card technically and Legally. But S 7 forced me to prepare the Russian Bank account. They never explain why they can’t refund to my card but they says the cash refund to the Russian account is only way to the refund. According to my credit card company, S7 has no reason they can’t do refund to the card. I believe this is their intention not to refund.I was very very disappointed. I strongly recommend not to use this air line.
reviews.author: Macha

reviews.title: I was denied entry for no reason.. Avoid this scam
reviews.text: The most terrible airline in the world. I was simply denied entry for no reason. I had transit through Bangkok, according to the rules, transit without visa is allowed as soon as I don't leave the airport and my transit is less than 10 hours, I have been doing that for years. But good luck explaining this simple thing to S7 staff. So I was denied entry the day of the flight. S7 staff was bringing random excuses how I don't hold visa to the last destination (to which I have valid e-visa and it won't be on S7 after Bangkok). The guy was just happy meaningless exuses and told us that our tickets are on sale already. I hate S7 and their staff in Irkusts. I will never take S7 again even if the only alternative is a slow train.
reviews.author: moulay idriss b

reviews.title: Money hungry scam
reviews.text: They don't care about their customers. All they want is more money. Disgusting attitude just because they know you don't have a choice.
reviews.author: Zarina

reviews.title: Great airline to travel to/from Moscow
reviews.text: In 2021 it has been the cheapest airline flying to/from Russia. They have a very decent level of service. And I like their flexibility in booking and adding features. Customer support is always there for you in the chat.
reviews.author: Aleksey S

reviews.title: Impressive customer service
reviews.text: Normally I wouldn't expect much from a budget airline, however I was pleasantly surprised from the moment I stepped into the airplane. The flight attendant Dmitriy approached me straight away offering his assistance in taking care of my hand luggage and escorting me to my seat (and I flew in economy, not business class!). Throughout the journey, the whole crew was very attentive, responsive, patient, polite and friendly. They were helpful and willing to go extra mile with a smile on their faces. I haven't seen this kind of dedication even in Qatar airways, which have been my favourite so far. The aircraft itself was small, but clean. Nothing remarkable, just standard. But the crew does make the difference, each and every team member. Kudos to them and the management that trains and motivates them properly! The only disappointing thing was that there was no notification of the flight delay, so I had to spend another 2.5 hours waiting at the airport. However this might have happened due to the fact that I booked my flight via the third party, so I cannot really blame the airline.
reviews.author: Little_sun_ray

reviews.title: S7 is one nasty airline - AVOID AVOID AVOID
reviews.text: I am a US citizen married to a Russian national. We planned a summer 2021 family adventure including 8 people, me my wife and 6 of her Russian relatives. Trip included roundtrip airfare from Saint Petersburg to Novosibirsk. On the return flight my wife's sister and her 17 year old son were denied boarding due to an oversold flight and treated extremely poorly. They were taken for a 1 hour drive far outside the city to cheap accomodations, and the only food provided during their 20 hour delay was a dry sandwich, roll and low end pastry. Nothing to drink. When my wife's sister asked for more food for her son she was denied. What inappropriate behavior by S7 and their employees.
reviews.author: Hunter M

reviews.title: Best looking flight attendants in the world !
reviews.text: The secret to get outstanding service on S7 is so simple! Prior to flying I had learnt basic Russian from YouTube "learn Russian while you sleep" The moment flight attendants heard me speaking Russian, they were super friendly and attentive to my needs. Food is good but don't expect fine cuisine . The advantage of the business class cabin is the people you meet... such as a champion wrestler and a KHL's ice hockey star player ! Conclusion: learn a little Russian before you fly S7 and a new world will open to you !
reviews.author: Capitaine B

reviews.title: Post covid S7 service dramatically downgraded
reviews.text: I used to fly S7 regularly before covid and first time too it after COVID. They were decent airline with good quality, almost always on schedule. My flight was delayed by over 30 min without any announcement and nobody present at the gate to advise passengers how long to wait. Finally, they started onboarding everyone. Apparently, due to cost optimizations, they stopped using air conditioners when they onboard passengers. It was 35C on board when we entered and we were waiting for a take off for over 30 min in this mode. Stewardess was helpless in providing any information. The airplane was also like 30 years old with passenger seats condensed to maximum degree. It is more like a low cost airline experience those their pricing 2-3x times higher. Totally opting out from their service.
reviews.author: Vyacheslav S

reviews.title: Schrecklich, schrecklicher, S7 Airline
reviews.text: Very rude and unfriendly stuff. If they have a little opportunity to feel yourself uncomfortable, they would do it. Also if they have some informations to help you, they would never inform you. It would be better for them to take someone off the plane as to help. They also make some racist comments if you are not Russian. Well, I would not recommend this airline to anybody. There are enough options to choose and much more better services to the same price. Ok
reviews.author: Valerie

reviews.title: Rude staff and cabin crew
reviews.text: Staff were not helpful at the check in desk. I am a musician and I had a very expensive professional guiter and they didn't allow me take it on the plane. I tried to explain that this is a music instrument in a soft case and it is impossible to have it with the checked in luggage. Even with the special buggage belt as you never know how they are going to handel it. I asked them to put in the jacket cabinet or overhead in the business class but they insist saying that it doesn't fit and the flight is fully booked. I was very late to the boarding and I didn't have the choice at the end but to leave them taking my guitar with the checked special luggage. When I got into the plane I discovered that the jacket cabinet was empty!! Furthermore, the overhead cabinets in the business class was empty too and could easily fit my guitar. I was the last one who got into the plane and still the cabin crew where very rude and refused to help me getting my instrument back and have with me on the flight. It was very bad experience and never again!!
reviews.author: taufik841

reviews.title: Decent Option for International Passengers
reviews.text: The airline its pretty good, overall experience was good and all things went as expected. S7 has really good airlines partners so good for people who have loyalty with other airlines and wish to take advantage while flying domestic in russia.
reviews.author: Syed Hunain Imran

reviews.title: Garbage site that does not work, horrible suppoort, terrible prices, hidden fees - Company went from 100 to 0 real quick
reviews.text: Never even got to buy the tickets - no way to pay with an international credit card, only Russian card. I stayed with the support on the line for an hour just for them to tell me that. Avoiud at all costs , .
reviews.author: Максим Л

reviews.title: S7
reviews.text: Thanks to cabin crew for the excellent service and comfortable flight. We have been served very tasty food quite professionally. Check-in, baggage handling, etc. procedures were quite successful.
reviews.author: Ozan Karahan

reviews.title: Controversial experience
reviews.text: We used S7 to get to Antalya in January and then get back to Moscow in February. Our first flight was really good. The aircraft was modern, with comfortable seats and enough feet space. The air company provided snacks and beverages. The flight was a bit late, but not by much, probably less than an hour. Unfortunately, our flight back home was one of the worst I remember. Firstly, the flight was scheduled on 4:25 pm. We arrived to the airport of Antalya at 2:20. At the same time S7 sent us an SMS that informed us about possible delay due to extreme weather conditions in Moscow. The flight was getting delayed many times and the overall delay was exactly 6 (!!!) hours. During that time S7’s office at the airport was closed, there were no representatives of the company, so no one apologized for that inconvenience, no one clarified the situation and of course no one offered us drinks and food during those 6 hours. Luckily, administration of the airport of Antalya gave us food and drinks, so big thanks to them, they took the responsibility for the problem instead of S7. When we finally got on the aircraft, we found out that it was really old: seats not suitable for adult people in terms of width and feet space, no climate control, so that it was really hot inside the aircraft and the air was dry. Final surprise was that mid-flight flight attendants announced that “they decided not to take food aboard”. Wow! You decided not to give us what we paid for, thank you! And of course, no social distancing, the aircraft was full of people. I guess, it’s an okay air company when there are no extreme situations.
reviews.author: danpro99

reviews.title: The Worst company concerning covid ever
reviews.text: Flight attendants don’t care about masks. 200 people just enjoying seating face to face without masks. After my complaint, flight attendant said that masks are recommendation and not mandatory. They said, If someone “needs” a mask, they can provide. That’s it!!! If you want to be infected covid - buy s7 ticket.
reviews.author: Roman

reviews.title: Great customer service by phone
reviews.text: Because of this pandemic travel plans had changed and therefore had to call S7 Airline to make changes, delayed by one day. Excellent communication in English, customer service was polite and courteous and extremely helpful and understanding. Even the return flight had some minor adjustments (delay) and S7 airline provided food while waiting for the flight to be ready for boarding. A special THANKS to the Flight attendants. Overall, EXTREMELY Satisfied.
reviews.author: Michel P

reviews.title: If you dont care about Covid this is the airline for you.
reviews.text: Having used S7 before i had no worries with booking this flight as they have never let me down before now. Having travelled from Bordeaux France via Paris and London Heathrow to get Moscow and using 2 different airlines i was aware of the flying policies. Both these airlines kept the middle seat free if you travelled alone and boarded the plane from rear to front and the reverse on exiting the aircraft to allow for social distancing and reinforced the wearing of masks. On boarding my S7 flight in Moscow as usual without an airbridge i expected the airline to provide extra busses, No we were shoehorned as usual onto 2 busses and half the occupants just either did not bother with a mask or wore it as a chin warmer. The aircraft was full and the 2 ladies next to me wore chin warmer masks and didn't seem to care. On the previous flights the aircrew stressed that if you needed to go to the toilet check to see if the light shows its free before moving and don't stand in the isles. This aircrew seemed not to care and never gave any instructions about the use of masks or standing in the isles so as i was at the rear of the aircraft at one point I had 4 people i didn't know crowded around my seat and not one of them was wearing any sort of protection and again the aircrew just seemed not to care but maybe that's why the infection rate in Russia is climbing because of the Russian mentality of rules dont apply to me. Also when landing in Simferopol everybody walked past the body heat sensor camera with the laptop connected all switched on and not a sole in sight monitoring anything. This flight made me very anxious for my health. However as usual S7 were on time and the flight was smooth and the aircraft was clean however unlike other airlines still had magazines in the seat backs and not new ones as these had already been used by who knows how many people.
reviews.author: Graeme K

reviews.title: Worst company I've ever seen
reviews.text: without any ratings and discussions... just avoid this company. Lie, rude and remove from social networks for bad Comments. It seems that the company works on the principle of a financial pyramid... never have business with this company...
reviews.author: vadymovchynnykov

reviews.title: Discussing regeneration counter
reviews.text: One of the most disgusting experiences in my life, I was with my wife going for our one year anniversary, the counter girl called Olesa was so rude to put us together ... when I asked her to try to do that she said that I have to pay for that!! When I used to work for Royal Jordanian I was providing every upgrade possible to Russian honeymooners! She even checked my bag as handbag although i told her that I have a bottle of wine there, she said : this is your problem, I cannot put less than 7kg luggage but handbag! Eventually they have confiscated the wine and I have to fly setting in the front of my wife!
reviews.author: Wisam D

reviews.title: So far so good!
reviews.text: I will follow up after the flight has taken place. I called customer service to book seats the lady was very polite and provided excellent service. Will write a follow up review after my wife returns. Anna & Michel Perreault
reviews.author: Michel P

reviews.title: Long Blonde Hair in Sandwich
reviews.text: I flew back to Russia to visit half of my family last summer. My flight got cancelled and I had to wait 12 hour layover to get to Volgograd. Staff at airport were rude and unhelpful. The flight had absolutely no legroom and was very uncomfortable. No in-flight entertainment and my food had a long blonde hair in it that surely wasn't mine (I have short, red hair) Nobody on the flight spoke a lick of English, which in my case was ok due to me being a half Russian who spoke Russian well enough to communicate but there were some Americans on my flight who didn't. In summary bad airline, rude staff.
reviews.author: Teresa McCain

reviews.title: SHAME ON YOU S7.. Fraud Company, Terrible Customer service..
reviews.text: Booked a return flight from Bangkok - Khabarovsk (Russia) - Bangkok in January 2020. Arrived to Russia for 13 days holiday with my wife and ONE YEAR OLD BABY. 3 days prior to our flight back to Bangkok, I receive an email says that my flights is cancelled, NO options were given, NO other routes were offered, No date's changes were offered. JUST NOTHING. Customer service never helped, Whenever we call them they just use a very rude tone and hang up the phone, like they are doing us a favour. They just refused to refund us our money and ripped us off. S7 is supposedly the biggest airline company in Russia, they are nothing like that but a fraud company, Taking people money for a service of transportation which they do only half of it and leaves you in a country of theirs at your own. You pay them for a certain service which you will never get! AVOID S7 even if they offer a discounted fare! just AVOID THEM!
reviews.author: User110619

reviews.title: Wars company I ever seen
reviews.text: I used this company a couple of times in 2014-15. Airplanes are old, not well groomed, maintenance leaves much to be desired. Money for canceled flights has to wait several months. I do not advise you to use this company
reviews.author: vadymovchynnykov

reviews.title: Largest domestic airline in Russia
reviews.text: S7/Siberian Airlines is a heaven’s sent for being the largest domestic airline in Russia and it also has some international flights. They do tick all the boxes for me and have the basics but the reason I am not giving them 5 stars is because of the delays I had and it wasn’t just once, on the other hand they have been very good at issuing vouchers however with my last flight that was cancelled due to recent events instead of refunding me the money on my account as promised along with another voucher no they issued me a voucher worth of something like £300 to use which is fine since I am planning to return to Russia but they have not consulted me to talk about it and some people probably would have preferred to get their money back on their accounts and use it for other things.
reviews.author: gorgeousgal1987

reviews.title: S7 cancels flight but offers no refund
reviews.text: Bought tickets for S7 flight via travel2be.com. Shortly after S7 cancelled the flight. The agent (travel2be.com) could not be reached by any means, nobody answers the phone or replies to emails. The airline reply to this is "it is your problem". They cancel the flight, they sell the tickets via agencies that cannot even pick up the phone, and the passenger has to suffer. They do not even want to receive the documents via email; instead they insist on etickets to be printed and sent to Russia via snail mail. Really nice customer service, S7.
reviews.author: And

reviews.title: Never trust this airline
reviews.text: I bought a fully refundable ticket. Then COVID came in. As per the agreement with this airline with terms and conditions sitting in the ticket, S7 is obliged to return the money. They didn’t. They offer vouchers for fully refundable tickets but no money.
reviews.author: OzziMelbourne

reviews.title: Don't trust it. Fraudulent and corrupt. Useless customer service.
reviews.text: We've booked the tickets specifically because we were promised a refund in case the situation with coronavirus changes. A week later we had to cancel the flight. Then suddenly we find out that they've changed the refund rules and no longer return the money but instead give a certificate that is absolutely useless to us. We tried calling customer services. The customer service representative was rude and the response was: "It is not our problem. The rules have changed a few days after you bought the ticket, so take it or leave it." It is a lawless company that does not respect its customers. They can change the rules any time they want without a warning.
reviews.author: Rus

reviews.title: It’s about business lounge In Domodedovo
reviews.text: This review is mostly for foreigners(guys don’t do the same mistake that I did) ... How disappointed I am, that I’m writing you directly from business lounge S7... After 24 hours hard flights without sleeping, i came BL S7 to have some rest,good atmosphere and shower. Hostess Ksenya met me with the smile, and there was only good thing that happened to me here. All stuff from second hostess(idk her name) to cleaning lady, waiter, and bartenders so serious-nobody is smiling, looks that only Ksenya is enjoying her job.have asked to hostesses like “do you know is in airport some Apple store, and god you should see/hear second hostess answer, I felt that I did something wrong that moment.and then I went to shower and the door was closed, after I asked to cleaning lady and she opened with biiiiig attitude.And after I could hear that she talking something b me with another coworker in Russian.I’ve been many lounges, but this kinda attitude and unwelcoming atmosphere didn’t see in my whole life.... The end of this I don’t understand for what I’ve paid... S7 if you want to be more international please teach your crew in BL how to be more welcoming and try to like the job that they do....
reviews.author: Jonathan L

reviews.title: Good flight, but 5 hours late
reviews.text: Flight was 5 hours late. New airplane, seat ok, good service, rapid check-in. Staff in Khabarovsk airport very friendly and helpful, including customs and immigration, even if I don't speak Russian...
reviews.author: skipschaf

reviews.title: Not Bad
reviews.text: Distance between chairs were not enough, but over all was not bad ! Services was too economy, stuff were Good , so if want to choice economy flight this is good choice ! Have good option for choice seat far from babies ,for us that was good Option
reviews.author: minataheri

reviews.title: Young mood onboard
reviews.text: Nice and your airline with bright colours and good mood. I enjoyed flying with it for the first time and I will probably choose it again in the future.
reviews.author: Giacomo C

reviews.title: Our first nightmare experience on S7 airline
reviews.text: We got noticed to the new gate so we ran into the gate, the staffs didn't invite us to get on board, chatting,laughing finally disappeared. While we were perplexed, the gate was closed, so we miss the plane.
reviews.author: Hyesun

reviews.title: Late most times
reviews.text: Travelled four times on S 7 airlines. Three times flight was late, thats a 75% for me. Staff is ok, aircraft were good too. But punctuality matters a lot. Food is just average quality and can improve. Website is useful for bookings etc.
reviews.author: Umar

reviews.title: Satisfied with S7
reviews.text: S7 Airlines continue to improve with a modern fleet, good reliability and inflight service. The carrier remains “full-service” a welcome contrast to the disappointing “no-frills” approach by carriers in the UK and beyond. Three trips taken in past year, IKT-DME, IAR-LED and DME-KZN have all been positive experiences-punctual with modern aircraft, professional cabin crew and satisfactory complimentary catering.
reviews.author: WorldTraveller0870

reviews.title: Barnaul
reviews.text: All is well for a short flight (35 min), however passengers need to wait in the unheated tent after boarding passes check and then go! to plane at -25C. This is more to airport than to airline. The plane is Embraer 170. Water is served while airborne.
reviews.author: Jumanjee

reviews.title: Very average, at best.
reviews.text: We only chose S7 Airlines because they are part of OneWorld and we could accumulate tier points/avios - it was more than double the price of Air Astana and I had a way better experience travelling with them on my outbound flight so I'm quite gutted I chose S7. The only benefits we got as being part of the alliance/silver members was that we got to choose our seats upfront, but because S7's system is so appalling I had to email the Priority team to amend it manually, this however then removed my British Airways Executive Club number and turned into a nightmare. The check in process is relatively simple, hand luggage racks are always rammed so get there early, however everybody tries to board at once due to a lack of organisation and this urgently needs resolving to make it a smoother process. Although I had a generally good experience with cabin crew, there was 1 in-particular who made me feel very unwelcome, she looked at you like a piece of dirt, refused to speak to you in English and snarled at you the whole flight when she walked past. I wouldn't fly them again due to being disorganised. I also didn't feel very comfortable transiting through Moscow.
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: the flights were ok nothing special but trying to get in touch with them is a nightmare.
reviews.text: Our suitcase was smashed, we have tied to contact them to get our compensation as it was a brand new suitcase. we have recieved no reply despite being in touch many times the flights were ok but don't trust the baggage
reviews.author: John F

reviews.title: Bangkok -Irkutsk- Saint Petersburg
reviews.text: Probably the lowest quality food and beverage! Almost rude and not friendly flight attendants, for such a long distance (7 hour+ 7.5 hours) nor working properly entertainment systems is a huge minus. The best was pilotage in landing! Can be so optimistic but can not find any other thing to give more plus. You may see “greek salad:)” as in fusion kitchen.
reviews.author: Ocean

reviews.title: A great surprise
reviews.text: The name S7 (Siberia 7) was nice to me, but it worried me a little. Instead, I put S7 at the top of the 10 airlines I flew with in 2019. A low-cost, of course, but the best for everything: food on board, cleanliness, sympathy, tolerance. Well done. I will be flying with S7 in 2020 too.
reviews.author: MaxPinucci

reviews.title: Trouble free, generally.
reviews.text: Started with a number of a little bit annoying attempts to sell extra services, like upgrade to seat to extra leg room or to a business class for a fee, before flight. For a minute I even get feeling that I'm preparing for Ryanair flight. ;) But once we got on board, this feeling disappeared completely. Cheerful and caring attendants quickly resolved all minute problems. Breakfast was typical for all flight that use DME catering services. This was 3-hour flight and plane was not equipped with a entertainment displays. But there was S7 Wi-Fi network, so anyone having a smartphone would connect with S7 application (yes, you have to download it before flight) and get access to selection of films, music and books. Unfortunately, I had no headphones for my smartphone, so was unable to use this option. Even forgot to check if there some power ports to keep smartphone charged during use of this system,
reviews.author: Velund489

reviews.title: The pilot door fault from the vibration.
reviews.text: The pilot of the aircraft try to fix the door, when we was on the air,the door fault and he try to put on position,the landing was scarefull.
reviews.author: Ilias

reviews.title: WARNING: Transit Visa - or you can't fly Bangkok to Berlin
reviews.text: I'm truly shocked: they wouldn't warn their customers. I asked and their answer was <<Immigration has nothing to do with us>>. Yeah, right.
reviews.author: mm1esg

reviews.title: Don't pay for the upgrade at check-in!!
reviews.text: Booking an upgrade from economy to business class is not worth it. You don't get priority boarding, you don't get lounge access, you don't get anything but the bigger seat.
reviews.author: Lauren B

reviews.title: Very punctual
reviews.text: Price is reasonable. No entertainment in flight. I like the colors they use. Very colorful and cheerful mood but the flight attendants were not so cheerful. Flight was took off and landed very on time. Good!
reviews.author: YK S

reviews.title: Better than i expected!
reviews.text: I was concerned, an internal flight with Siberian Airways doesn't sound like something to look forward to as.a.non Russian speaker. My flights were on time, announcements were in Russian and English, there were refreshments - the legroom wasn't great but when the last in front called the attendant to complain the my knees were sticking in her back when she reclined her chair, she told her to move her chair, then explained in broken English what had happened. Many thanks.
reviews.author: Dave C

reviews.title: Avoid this corrupt company
reviews.text: First of all, I wanted to visit Russia more than any country for decades. Then, when I did it was absolutely shocking. Russia is a pure and simple dictatorship with corrupt little and angry bureaucrats with no sense of costumer service. So, most everyone uses his/her position to get rich at any price . . . As for my experience with S7, they decided that I need to have a visa to enter Russia although I was only transferring within less than 4 hours from one flight to another. This is clearly against what the "government's" policy! But, they decided to leave me stranded for several hours in Seoul, tired, hungry, and frustrated in a deserted airport. Then, they put me on another flight and charged my credit card over $1500 for another ticket. I challenged that through my credit card and it was resolved in my favor. As I reflect back on the situation, I did some research regarding corruption in Russia's arbitrary system, I feel quite lucky. My advice: Avoid S7 and Russia altogether.
reviews.author: Jean

reviews.title: Efficient Airline
reviews.text: We flew Moscow to Saint Petersburg and S7 were great. Service was good flight was quick, a basic snack and drink was offered. Fares are quite reasonable if you book early, which is advisable as flights fill up quickly.
reviews.author: helen d

reviews.title: Simple but it works
reviews.text: They don't have on board entertainment. But do you actually have to be glued to your electronic entertainment when you are going on a trip. Like seriously, if you are the type that stared at your phone whenever you're bored, you should ponder about how you are living. For the price that I've paid, they've kept me fed, like 4 hours a meal. Then the legroom is built for tall Ruskies. Also, yes they don't speak English well but you are in their nation so it's only common sense or respect that you should know a few word.
reviews.author: Michael K

reviews.title: Good service, let down only by the aged appointments (seats etc).
reviews.text: I was a little hestitant flying with S7, but the take-off, inflight and landing were excellent. The cabin staff were most attentive, and to understand there are only eight seats in business class, all full. The only negative comments are the aged seats, no footrests, little lumber support. The latter can be fixed with the pillow, and we had plenty of legroom as you'd expect. The only let-down was beyond the control of the cabin staff, being the screaming baby for the full five hour flight. They should have seats on the wing for these people! Plenty of luggage allowance - more than anyone else we've flown with.
reviews.author: Grahame F

reviews.title: Made us pay again for bags we had already bought
reviews.text: We had bought 2 bags and because of a problem with their computer system we had to pay for them again at the airport, since nobody in the whole company staff was able to do anything about it.
reviews.author: Luca
